fields.text: AHI classification: Mild = 5–14.9 events/hr; Moderate = 15–29.9 events/hr; Severe = ≥30 events/hr. SURMOUNT-OSA enrolled patients with AHI ≥15 (moderate-to-severe). FDA approval of Zepbound for OSA requires moderate-to-severe OSA.

fields.name: osa_severity
fields.label: What is the patient's confirmed OSA severity by polysomnography (PSG) or home sleep apnea test (HSAT)?

fields.text: FDA approval of Zepbound for OSA requires obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m²). SURMOUNT-OSA mean BMI was 38.8 kg/m². The OSA-obesity indication is distinct from the weight management indication.

SURMOUNT-OSA excluded patients with T2DM. The Zepbound OSA indication is specifically for patients WITHOUT T2DM. Patients with T2DM and OSA who need GIP/GLP-1 therapy should use Mounjaro (tirzepatide for T2DM) — a separate indication. Semaglutide (Ozempic/Wegovy) may be considered for weight management in T2DM patients with OSA.

fields.name: diabetes_status
fields.label: Does the patient have type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)?

fields.text: SURMOUNT-OSA enrolled two cohorts: Trial 1 (unable/unwilling to use PAP) and Trial 2 (on PAP ≥3 months). Both showed significant AHI reduction with tirzepatide. Zepbound is approved as adjunct to PAP or as standalone therapy when PAP is not used.

fields.name: pap_status
fields.label: What is the patient's current PAP therapy status?

fields.text: Absolute contraindications to Zepbound: personal/family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 2 (MEN2). Relative contraindications: prior acute/chronic pancreatitis, severe GI disease, pregnancy.

fields.name: contraindications
fields.label: Does the patient have any of the following contraindications to tirzepatide (Zepbound)?

options.label: Personal or family history of MTC or MEN2
History of acute or chronic pancreatitis
Severe gastroparesis or GI motility disorder

fields.text: Most payer prior authorization criteria require documentation of ≥1 unsuccessful dietary attempt to lose weight before approving Zepbound. SURMOUNT-OSA required ≥1 self-reported unsuccessful dietary attempt as an inclusion criterion.

fields.name: prior_weight_loss
fields.label: Has the patient attempted dietary/lifestyle weight loss prior to pharmacologic therapy?

options.label: Yes — currently enrolled in structured weight management program

fields.text: Only tirzepatide (Zepbound) has FDA approval specifically for OSA. Semaglutide (Wegovy) is FDA-approved for chronic weight management but NOT for OSA as a specific indication. Semaglutide produces 12–15% average weight loss which can improve OSA severity; it may be considered off-label or when tirzepatide is not tolerated/available.

fields.name: glp1_preference
fields.label: Which pharmacologic agent is being considered?

options.label: Semaglutide (Wegovy) — weight management, off-label for OSA
